recommendation.reason: For this non-agentic benchmark, the best reported QA system scores 41.4% F1, and citation attention is strong.
risks: Confirm that the task data was released; the paper only announces future availability.
Assess whether token-overlap F1 reliably scores paraphrased answers.
Reward hacking and contamination defenses are not stated.

release.quote: This is the official release accompanying our EMNLP 2023 paper, [FActScore: Fine-grained Atomic Evaluation of Factual Precision in Long Form Text Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.14251).

redistribution_questions: Can the released human annotations and FActScore results be redistributed?
Is there a separate license for the data and model outputs?

tasks.quote: There're two sets of prompt entities, `data/labeled/prompt_entities.txt` (183 entities) and `data/unlabeled/prompt_entities.txt` (500 entities).

verifier.quote: It uses large language models and retrieval to break down generations into atomic facts and then measure the correctness with respect to a knowledge source (like Wikipedia).

oracle.quote: The data we release includes human annotations of factual precision reported in Section 3 of [the paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.14251).

exceptions: ChatGPT-only mode can skip `--llama_7B_HF_path`; LLAMA-7B reconstruction requires HuggingFace weights
runtime.quote: This requires having access to HuggingFace weights of the LLAMA-7B model, which are added to the `--llama_7B_HF_path` flag. Follow [this guide](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/model_doc/llama) in order to obtain those weights. Skip the `--llama_7B_HF_path` if you would only like to use the ChatGPT version of FActScore.

questions: Is FActScore the intended release for locomo, or is this a mismatched repo?
What license covers the released annotations and FActScore predictions?
Which scorer should the adapter pin: retrieval+ChatGPT or retrieval+llama+npm?
How should prompt entities be mapped to locomo tasks and splits?
readiness.next_action: Confirm the FActScore/locomo mismatch before adapting; if FActScore is intended, pin the repo and start with `data/labeled/prompt_entities.txt`.
